finding: The Harness detected that the actual invocation occurred outside the recorded effective authority boundary.
evidence: Approved and actual material parameters matched.
The invoked operation was outside the recorded effective authority boundary.
why_it_matters: Approval-to-action integrity is not sufficient when the resulting invocation falls outside the effective authority granted to the actor.
scope: Controlled validation of one recorded authority-boundary failure mechanism in a ServiceNow reference environment.
